Tooltip_ZD_Backend: The game does not allow temporary invisibility in this context, or the public API is unavailable. Ordinary non-debug single-player is blocked on inspected42.19.2. No blood is applied when the effect is refused. No native extension is required.
Tooltip_ZD_Peers: Waiting for every connected client to acknowledge this Lua invisibility version. Older versions or missing acknowledgments disable new disguises and revoke active effects.
Tooltip_ZD_HealthDisabled: Optional Field Medicine integration is disabled; camouflage does not require it.
Tooltip_ZD_Risk: Apply blood to exposed skin. Default duration is120 game minutes. Running, attacking or saving breaks it. Uses built-in invisibility, including its visibility and sound behavior. With Field Medicine installed and enabled, blood over wounds or the face can cause common illness. Wash actual blood off to reduce exposure; medicines do not renew camouflage.
Tooltip_ZD_Dependency: Field Medicine is optional. Blood-exposure integration is used only when a compatible API v1 is enabled.
Tooltip_ZD_Active: Existing disguise does not renew automatically. Saving, expiry or hostile activity ends it. With Field Medicine, residual blood exposure remains until washing.
Tooltip_ZD_Reach: Use an accessible zombie corpse on the same floor within two tiles. Stay still until the action completes.
